issues.description: Field 'lectureName' in class Lecture: the UML diagram in problem_statement.md declares the attribute as type int (line 64: "-lectureName: int"), while the exercise text, the example toString(), and the reference solution declare and use lectureName as a String (solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 6: "private String lectureName;"). This contradicting type information can mislead students about the correct field type and the constructor/getter/setter signatures they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Edit problem_statement.md to correct the UML declaration for lectureName to use type String (e.g. change "-lectureName: int" to "-lectureName: String") so it matches the textual examples and the solution. Verify the example toString() and any descriptive text consistently show lectureName as a String. Optionally add a brief note in the template Lecture.java or problem statement clarifying the intended types to avoid confusion.
